newsitem.title: FRANCE: Latest massacre in Algeria's litany of bloodshed.
newsitem.headline: Latest massacre in Algeria's litany of bloodshed.

text.p: Moslem rebels slaughtered 47 people, mostly by cutting their throats, in two attacks south of Algiers, an Algerian newspaper said on Wednesday.
The massacre followed a pattern of killings of civilians mainly in the past year, in a new element in the five and a half years of conflict pitting Algerian rebels against government forces.
Following is a list of the worst massacres reported by newspapers, authorities or residents:
Nov 3
- Moslem rebels killed 10 women and three children, cutting their throats in Douaouda village near Algiers.
Nov 5
- Moslem guerrillas slaughtered 31 people in Sidi el Kebit village, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers. Among the dead were a newly married man, his bride and 10 other women.
Nov 12
- Twelve villagers, including four women and three children, killed by rebels in Douar Ben Salah.
Nov 13
- Eighteen villagers die in two raids in Medea province, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers.
Dec 5
- Moslem rebels kill 19 people in night raid at Benachour, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
Jan 4
- About 50 rebels, split in four groups, massacre 16 villagers in Ben Achour hamlet, 50 km (30 miles) south of the Algerian capital.
Jan 5
- Rebels kill 18 villagers in Douaouda hamlet, southwest of Algiers.
Jan 12
- Moslem guerrillas kill 14 villagers in Tabainat, in Blida province, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
Jan 14
- Nine bodies found in Djebel Koukou in Algiers and Bab Ali village, near Algiers.
Jan 19
- Moslem rebels kill 36 people in Sidi Abdelaziz village, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers.
Jan 23
- Rebels kill 15 villagers, including 10 women, in Ali Baba farm community south of Algiers.
Feb 17
- About 30 guerrillas hack to death 33 villagers in Kerrach hamlet, 60 km (40 miles) south of Algiers.
April 5
- Moslem guerrillas massacre all 52 inhabitants of a hamlet in Medea province, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers.
April 11
- Rebels kill 22 people in Menaa village near Boufarik, 30 km (18 miles) south of Algiers.
April 13
- Rebels slaughter 30 villagers in Chebli area, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
April 21-22
- Rebels knife and hack to death 93 villagers, including 43 women and young girls, and three children, in Bougara area.
May 15
- Suspected rebels slaughtered 30 people, including two babies and seven women, overnight at Chebli village in Blida province.
June 23
- Suspected Moslem guerrillas cut the throats of 18 people, including a four-year-old child and a six-month-old baby, in a village at Mouzaia area, 60 km (40 miles) southwest of Algiers.
July 7
- Suspected rebels killed 51 civilians in four attacks in Algiers and the neighbouring province of Medea.
July 13
- Suspected Moslem militants killed at least 44 villagers overnight in villages near Ksar el Boukhari, southwest of Algiers.
July 23
- Suspected Moslem guerrillas killed 47, mostly by cutting their throats, in two villages near Blida town during the night of July 20-21.
